description: Reacts to a tugger fault: finds the seat sets on the faulted tugger, picks healthy tuggers from Supplier B's fleet and the OPC UA chargers, asks Supplier B to move the loads, and reports each step. A plain service, not a collaboration.

OutboundUIUpdate.description: This outbound event was added by the Design Modeler 'com.vantiqse.imo.Design'.

interface.name: handle
interface.description: Handles a tugger fault or Supplier B's report that it moved the loads, and returns a UI update.

interface.name: reassign
interface.description: Moves the faulted tugger's seat sets onto healthy tuggers by writing requests into Supplier B's tugger_requests, and returns a UI update.

interface.name: moved
interface.description: Turns Supplier B's report that it moved the loads into a UI update with the recomputed buffer.

name: com.vantiqse.imo.Fleet
